name: Nick Alessi
source:
Nick Alessi is a capo in the Bellarosa crime syndicate. A made man suspected of multiple murders, arson, and other violent crimes. At 19 he took the wrap for a murder committed by this best friend [url=/c176673]Vincenzo[/url]. The Bellarosa family lawyers got the charge dropped to manslaughter, and he was back on the streets 4 years later. The reward was ample, and partly responsible for Nick's position in the family. Nick is surprisingly well respected by civilians and criminals alike.

[Edited from in-game description]
